2607.28166.title: Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
2607.28166.paper_summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adaptive sampling, the other axis of training-free acceleration, paces how quickly positions commit while decoding continues but never verifies that the output itself has stabilized. We introduce a training-free, candidate-aware early-exit framework that keeps the two axes separate and matches each decision to evidence of its own scope. Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC) governs when the sequence may stop by verifying confidence and sustained argmax stability over the dynamically extracted candidate span using a deterministic parser specified from each task's output format. Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC) governs where to accelerate by applying a cheaper local rule to non-final blocks, while leaving the final block and global termination under CVC. We refer to their combination as LATCH (Localized Acceleration with Tracked-Candidate Halting). Unlike prior methods, LATCH needs no suffix-prompt construction; it is prompt-anchor-free but format-aware. We evaluate LATCH end to end on 11 tasks under zero-shot settings using LLaDA and Dream. LATCH stays within 2.0 percentage points of full-decoding accuracy across all 22 evaluation settings, with one frozen hyperparameter set that transfers cross-backbone untuned, while achieving end-to-end TPS speedups of 9.3-17.8x on short-answer tasks and 2.0-3.3x on long-reasoning tasks.
2607.28166.paper_summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（DLMs）在每個去噪步驟中提供臨時預測，創造了在生成時提前退出的機會，讓解碼在計劃耗盡之前停止。現有的提前退出閘門根據固定區域的信心統計或依賴於計劃的規則來決定終止，這些證據對於一個同時凍結所有剩餘位置的決定來說過於粗糙，因此它們在長思考鏈的輸出上過早觸發，這些輸出的答案只有在接近結尾時才會穩定。自適應抽樣，作為無需訓練的加速的另一個維度，控制著在解碼繼續時位置承諾的速度，但從未驗證輸出本身是否已經穩定。我們提出了一個無需訓練的、候選人感知的提前退出框架，將這兩個維度保持分開，並將每個決策與其自身範圍的證據相匹配。信心驗證承諾（CVC）通過驗證信心和在動態提取的候選範圍內的持續argmax穩定性來管理序列何時可以停止，使用從每個任務的輸出格式指定的確定性解析器。區塊級提前承諾（BWEC）則通過對非最終區塊應用更便宜的局部規則來管理加速的地點，同時將最終區塊和全局終止留給CVC。我們將它們的結合稱為LATCH（帶有跟踪候選停止的局部加速）。與之前的方法不同，LATCH不需要後綴提示的構建；它是無提示錨的，但對格式敏感。我們在零樣本設置下使用LLaDA和Dream對11個任務進行了LATCH的端到端評估。LATCH在所有22個評估設置中保持在全解碼準確率的2.0個百分點內，並且在一組凍結的超參數下進行跨骨架的無調整轉移，同時在短答案任務上實現了9.3-17.8倍的端到端TPS加速，在長推理任務上實現了2.0-3.3倍的加速。
